contentText: US President Donald Trump said on Saturday he was looking at whether Venezuela's opposition leader Maria Corina Machado might lead the country after President Nicolas Maduro was captured and flown out of the country. Maduro has been slammed with terrorism and drug charges by the US after a "large-scale strike" rocked Caracas with explosions and aircraft-like sounds. Venezuelan writer, Author of "I killed Simon Bolivar", Vicente Ulive, shares his insights.
